messages:
Maya (PM): Heads-up: customer pilot (AcmeCorp) just asked for per-tenant rate limits and SAML before launch. This collides with our MVP timeline. Need quick alignment.
Kofi (SRE): Per-tenant rate limits are mostly config + a throttle layer. But testing adds ~1 sprint of validation across regions.
Rin (Eng): SAML is larger scope: IDP metadata, metadata refresh, cert rotation, and a user-provisioning edge case. That's definitely v1 unless we accept a manual setup process.
Lena (Sales): Acme has a signed LOI that references "enterprise auth" in the pilot plan. They expect SAML in pilot or they'll defer. We can propose a temporary workaround.
Maya (PM): Options: 1) push pilot by 2 sprints to include SAML and per-tenant throttles, 2) ship MVP with a manual SAML onboarding and rate-limit defaults, or 3) cut tenant throttles and keep SAML as v1 (not ideal). Thoughts?
Ollie (Design): If we go manual onboarding, we need a clear admin checklist and an in-app banner explaining limitations. We can draft that quickly.
Kofi (SRE): Manual onboarding still needs us to ensure the routing and auth hooks won't break. That's light testing but still nonzero.
Rin (Eng): Technical trade: per-tenant throttles intersect with our embeddings cache eviction policy. If we delay throttles, cache pressure from one noisy tenant could affect others. We can add a simple global cap as a stopgap.
Maya (PM): How fast can we implement a global cap + manual SAML workflow and safely onboard Acme?
Rin (Eng): I can get a global cap and admin checklist out in 4 days. Manual SAML flow (handshake + cert upload UI) is ~10 dev days including tests.
Lena (Sales): If we commit to manual SAML onboarding for pilot and a clear v1 date for full SAML, Acme is willing to proceed. They want the v1 date in writing.
Maya (PM): Proposed decision: MVP includes global cap + manual SAML onboarding (Ops-assisted). Per-tenant throttles moved to v1. We promise SAML GA in v1 by 2024-06-30. Approve?
Kofi (SRE): Approve with caveat: we should instrument cache eviction and throttle headroom before pilot.
Ollie (Design): I'll produce the admin checklist and the in-app banner copy.
Rin (Eng): I'll scope the manual SAML UI tasks and the global cap PR.
Lena (Sales): I'll get Acme to sign the pilot amendment that includes the manual onboarding and the v1 target date.
status-bot: Reminder: Release freeze scheduled 2024-05-03 to 2024-05-06.
Maya (PM): Action items: Rin — global cap PR + tests; Kofi — eviction instrumentation; Ollie — admin checklist and banner; Lena — pilot amendment. Decision locked for EOD.
Rin (Eng): Uploaded draft PR: /docs/release/global-cap-1735558888.md
Kofi (SRE): Eviction metrics updated on staging dashboard. Alerting thresholds recommended.
Ollie (Design): Banner copy draft: "Tenant-level rate limits available in v1. For now, contact your CSM for per-tenant setup."
Lena (Sales): Acme legal signed the amendment. They accepted the timeline for SAML GA: 2024-06-30.
Maya (PM): Great. Locking this cut. We'll track per-tenant throttles as a v1 ticket with priority-high. Closing thread after I update the milestone board.
